title: Model Core Abstractions
summary: This module defines the foundational abstract classes and utilities for interacting with large language models, providing a consistent interface for different providers and enabling advanced functionalities like streaming and concurrency control.

nodes.label: Base Model Interfaces
nodes.title: Base Model Interfaces
nodes.description: Defines the core abstract classes for interacting with LLMs, including Model and StreamedResponse, establishing a common interface for all model implementations.

nodes.label: Model Wrapper Classes
nodes.title: Model Wrapper Classes
nodes.description: Provides abstract classes for wrapping existing model implementations, allowing for the extension or modification of model behavior without altering the original model.

nodes.label: Model Utilities
nodes.title: Model Utilities
nodes.description: Contains utility functions for managing model interactions, such as concurrency limiting and HTTP client caching.

nodes.label: Provider Abstractions
nodes.title: Provider Abstractions
nodes.description: Defines abstract interfaces for different model providers, allowing for standardized interaction regardless of the underlying service.

groups.label: Core Interfaces
groups.title: Core Model Interfaces
groups.description: Fundamental abstract definitions that all model implementations and extensions adhere to.

groups.label: Model Extension & Control
groups.title: Model Extension and Control
groups.description: Components that extend or control the behavior of core model abstractions, such as wrappers and concurrency limiters.
